    require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode), "not a regular file: " + str(path))
    require(not (info.st_mode & (stat.S_ISUID | stat.S_ISGID)), "set-ID input: " + str(path))
    return info

def relative(name):
    value = pathlib.PurePosixPath(name)
    require(value.parts and str(value) == name and not value.is_absolute() and
            all(x not in ("", ".", "..", ".git") for x in value.parts),
            "invalid source relative path")
    return value

def inventory(base, skip_git=False):
    rows = {}
    for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(base, followlinks=False):
        if skip_git:
            dirs[:] = [x for x in dirs if x != ".git"]
            files = [x for x in files if x != ".git"]
        for name in sorted(dirs + files):
            path = P(directory) / name
            rel = str(path.relative_to(base))
            info = path.lstat()
            if stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
                rows[rel] = {"kind": "file", "sha256": digest(path),
                             "bytes": info.st_size, "mode": stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)}
            elif stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
                rows[rel] = {"kind": "symlink", "target": os.readlink(path)}
            else:
                require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode), "unsupported source object: " + rel)
    return rows

def hashes(base, skip_git=False):
    rows = inventory(base, skip_git)
    require(all(row["kind"] == "file" for row in rows.values()),
            "this frozen candidate requires regular source files")
    return {name: row["sha256"] for name, row in rows.items()}

def save(path, data):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(data, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())

def output(argv, timeout=30):
    value = subprocess.run(argv, check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
    require(len(value.stdout) <= 65536 and len(value.stderr) <= 65536, "unexpected command output")
    return value.stdout.decode("utf-8").strip()

def git(base, *args):
    return output(["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(base), *args])

def no_alias(path):
    require(path.is_absolute() and ".." not in path.parts, "non-absolute or parent path")
    for parent in [path, *path.parents]:
        if parent.exists() or parent.is_symlink():
            info = parent.lstat()
            require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode), "path aliases a symlink or non-directory")

def owned_resource_gate(text):
    require(isinstance(text, str), "owned memory.events was not observed")
    rows = [line.split() for line in text.splitlines()]
    require(rows and all(len(row) == 2 and row[1].isdigit() for row in rows),

    require(len(events) == len(rows) and all(name in events for name in ("oom", "oom_kill", "oom_group_kill")),

    require(events["oom_kill"] == 0 and events["oom_group_kill"] == 0,
            "owned OOM kill observed; build is not qualified")
    return {"pass": True, "events": events, "owned_oom_kills_zero": True}

            "actual projected Soong source differs from the exact one-byte Go5 expectation")
    require(actual["files"][BLUEPRINT_SOURCE] == BLUEPRINT_SOURCE_SHA,
            "actual projected Blueprint writer differs from the tested candidate")
    return {"patch_path": GO_PATCH, "patch_sha256": GO_PATCH_SHA,

            "projected_soong_path": SOONG_SOURCE,

def write_runtime_budget_patch():
    # This is a private copy owned by the new preparation, never live AOSP or
    # the original compiled source. Keep its length, inode and mode unchanged.
    path = BUILD_SOURCE / GO_PATCH
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "r+b") as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_size == 583,
                "copied runtime patch is not the exact regular preimage")
        raw = stream.read(584)
        require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == COMPILED_GO_PATCH_SHA and
                raw.count(b'"6GiB"') == 1, "copied Go6 patch changed before derivation")
        value = raw.replace(b'"6GiB"', b'"5GiB"')
        require(len(value) == len(raw) and hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest() == GO_PATCH_SHA,
                "derived Go5 patch differs")
        stream.seek(0)
        require(stream.write(value) == len(value), "short runtime patch write")
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        named = path.lstat()
        require((after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_mode, after.st_size) ==
                (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_mode, before.st_size) and
                (named.st_dev, named.st_ino) == (after.st_dev, after.st_ino),
                "runtime patch identity changed")
    require(digest(path) == GO_PATCH_SHA, "written runtime patch differs")

def subreaper():
    # Only this newly owned controller process is changed.
    signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD, signal.SIG_DFL)
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    libc.prctl.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong]
    libc.prctl.restype = ctypes.c_int
    require(libc.prctl(36, 1, 0, 0, 0) == 0, "cannot establish owned-child subreaper")

def child_ids():
    # The controller is single threaded and owns all of its subprocesses.
    require(os.readlink("/proc/self") == str(os.getpid()),
            "controller proc view does not match its PID namespace")
    text = P("/proc/thread-self/children").read_text()
    values = [int(x) for x in text.split()]
    require(len(values) <= 4096 and all(x > 1 for x in values), "unexpected owned child set")
    return values

def cleanup_children():
    records = []
    errors = []
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 8
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        try:
            children = child_ids()
        except Exception as error:
            return {"complete": False, "children": records,
                    "errors": errors + [{"operation": "enumerate", "error": repr(error)}]}
        if not children:
            return {"complete": not errors, "children": records, "errors": errors}
        for pid in children:
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                break
            fd = -1
            try:
                fd = os.pidfd_open(pid, 0)
                # No other thread/handler reaps a child. A zombie still holds its
                # PID until this exact waitpid; pidfd binds the kernel object.
                try:
                    signal.pidfd_send_signal(fd, signal.SIGKILL, None, 0)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
                stop = min(deadline, time.monotonic() + 1)
                status = None
                while time.monotonic() < stop:
                    got, value = os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
                    if got == pid:
                        status = value
                        break
                    time.sleep(0.01)
                records.append({"pid": pid, "wait_status": status, "reaped": status is not None})
            except Exception as error:
                errors.append({"pid": pid, "operation": "pidfd_stop_or_wait", "error": repr(error)})
            finally:
                if fd >= 0:
                    try:
                        os.close(fd)
                    except OSError as error:
                        errors.append({"pid": pid, "operation": "close_pidfd", "error": repr(error)})
        time.sleep(0.01)
    try:
        remaining = child_ids()
    except Exception as error:
        remaining = None
        errors.append({"operation": "final_enumerate", "error": repr(error)})
    return {"complete": remaining == [] and not errors, "children": records,
            "errors": errors, "remaining": remaining}

struct Request {
  pid_t caller_tid;
  int caller_fd;
  Operation operation;
  void* context;
  bool pin_caller_fd = true;
  Publication publication = nullptr;
  char publication_path[160]{};
  // 0 preparing; 1 caller publication requested; 2 publication acknowledged;
  // 3 completed. The owner never accesses request/context after completion.
  std::atomic<int> phase{0};
  int result = -1;
  int error = EIO;
  std::atomic<bool> complete{false};
};

void ChangePhase(Request* request, int phase) {
  request->phase.store(phase, std::memory_order_release);
  syscall(SYS_futex, &request->phase, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, INT_MAX, nullptr, nullptr, 0);
}

void WaitWhile(Request* request, int phase) {
  while (request->phase.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == phase) {
    syscall(SYS_futex, &request->phase, FUTEX_WAIT_PRIVATE, phase, nullptr, nullptr, 0);
  }
}

int PublishPreparedFile(Request* request, int caller_pidfd) {
  OwnedFd prepared(request->operation(caller_pidfd, request->context));
  if (prepared.get() < 0) return -1;
  // Use the procfs mount's actual numeric view. getpid/gettid can name a
  // different PID namespace than this mount (including the host test runner).
  OwnedFd directory(open("/proc/thread-self/fd", O_PATH | O_DIRECTORY | O_CLOEXEC));
  if (directory.get() < 0) return -1;
  struct statfs fs{};
  if (fstatfs(directory.get(), &fs) < 0) return -1;
  if (static_cast<unsigned long>(fs.f_type) != PROC_SUPER_MAGIC) return Error(EXDEV);
  char label[96];
  const ssize_t length = readlink("/proc/thread-self", label, sizeof(label) - 1);
  if (length < 0) return -1;
  if (length == 0 || static_cast<size_t>(length) >= sizeof(label) - 1) return Error(EXDEV);
  label[length] = '\0';
  const int written = snprintf(request->publication_path, sizeof(request->publication_path),
                               "/proc/%s/fd/%d", label, prepared.get());
  if (written <= 0 || static_cast<size_t>(written) >= sizeof(request->publication_path)) {
    return Error(EOVERFLOW);
  }
  ChangePhase(request, 1);
  WaitWhile(request, 1);
  if (request->phase.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 2) return Error(EIO);
  // The caller has completed the sole public open. All subsequent closes are
  // in this independent table, even if its numeric slots are reused by guests.
  return 0;
}

int InitializePrivateTable() {
  // Until unshare succeeds this is still the caller's fd table. In particular,
  // do not close any descriptor on the failure path before this boundary.
  if (syscall(SYS_unshare, CLONE_FILES) < 0) return -1;
#ifdef SYS_close_range
  // Drop this owner's inherited references. This both avoids prolonging their
  // lifetimes and leaves room for the pin even if the caller is at RLIMIT_NOFILE.
  if (syscall(SYS_close_range, 0u, UINT_MAX, 0u) < 0) return -1;
#else
  return Error(ENOSYS);
#endif
  return 0;
}

int PerformInPrivateTable(Request& request) {
#ifdef SYS_pidfd_open
  OwnedFd caller(static_cast<int>(syscall(SYS_pidfd_open, request.caller_tid, O_EXCL)));
  if (caller.get() < 0) return -1;
#else
  return Error(ENOSYS);
#endif
#if defined(SYS_pidfd_open) && defined(SYS_pidfd_getfd)
  if (request.publication != nullptr) return PublishPreparedFile(&request, caller.get());
  if (!request.pin_caller_fd) return request.operation(caller.get(), request.context);
  // This syscall is the descriptor selection/linearization point. Passing the
  // caller's fd number to fstat in the owner would select a different table.
  OwnedFd pinned(static_cast<int>(syscall(SYS_pidfd_getfd, caller.get(), request.caller_fd, 0)));
  if (pinned.get() < 0) return -1;
  return request.operation(pinned.get(), request.context);
#else
  return Error(ENOSYS);
#endif
}

int Perform(Request& request) {
  if (InitializePrivateTable() < 0) return -1;
  return PerformInPrivateTable(request);
}

void* Run(void* context) {
  auto* request = static_cast<Request*>(context);
  errno = 0;
  request->result = Perform(*request);
  request->error = errno;
  // Perform has destroyed every private descriptor before this final access
  // to the caller's request. No callback/context access follows this store.
  ChangePhase(request, 3);
  request->complete.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
  return nullptr;
}

// existing temporary owner remains the default. No TLS is used here: raw
// CLONE_VM guest processes can share the caller's host TLS while having a
// distinct TGID. Such a process must not reset or join this process's owner.
struct ReusableOwner {

  // reopening admission while Stop is waiting for an in-flight request.

  std::atomic<int> command{0};

  std::atomic<bool> startup_done{false};
  std::atomic<bool> exited{false};

  // private-memory fork. A child can reuse its own COW mapping instead of
  // needing another stack mmap after the application has lowered RLIMIT_AS.
  // CLONE_VM/new-TGID admission is rejected before this storage can be touched.
  void* stack_mapping = nullptr;
  void* stack_base = nullptr;

void NotifyReusable() {

  syscall(SYS_futex, &g_reusable.event, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, INT_MAX,

void WaitReusableEvent(int observed) {

          nullptr, nullptr, 0UL);

int CurrentProcess() { return static_cast<int>(syscall(SYS_getpid)); }

bool OwnsReusableState() {
  return g_reusable.process.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == CurrentProcess();
}

class ReusableGate {
 public:
  int Enter() {
    if (!OwnsReusableState()) return Error(EOPNOTSUPP);
    for (;;) {
      int expected = 0;
      if (g_reusable.gate.compare_exchange_weak(expected, 1, std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        held_ = true;
        return 0;
      }
      syscall(SYS_futex, &g_reusable.gate, FUTEX_WAIT_PRIVATE, 1,
              nullptr, nullptr, 0UL);
    }
  }
  ~ReusableGate() {
    if (!held_) return;
    const int saved = errno;
    g_reusable.gate.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    syscall(SYS_futex, &g_reusable.gate, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, INT_MAX,
            nullptr, nullptr, 0UL);
    errno = saved;
  }

  bool held_ = false;
};

void* RunReusable(void*) {
  errno = 0;
  const int initialized = InitializePrivateTable();
  g_reusable.startup_error = initialized < 0 ? errno : 0;
  if (initialized < 0) g_reusable.exited.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
  g_reusable.startup_done.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
  NotifyReusable();
  if (initialized < 0) return nullptr;
  for (;;) {
    const int observed = g_reusable.event.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const int command = g_reusable.command.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (command == 2) break;
    if (command != 1) {
      WaitReusableEvent(observed);
      continue;
    }
    Request* request = g_reusable.slot.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    // Only the admitted caller owns gate and publishes a non-null slot.
    // The caller cannot return until the completion store below.
    errno = 0;
    request->result = PerformInPrivateTable(*request);
    request->error = errno;
    g_reusable.slot.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
    g_reusable.command.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    request->complete.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    // Do not access request again, including for futex wake. The caller may
    // already have returned and destroyed its stack request. Wake via the
    // process-lifetime event word instead.
    NotifyReusable();
  }
  g_reusable.exited.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
  NotifyReusable();
  return nullptr;
}

int RunReusableRequest(int fd, Operation operation, void* context) {
  if (fd < 0) return Error(EBADF);
  if (operation == nullptr) return Error(EINVAL);
  if (!OwnsReusableState()) return Error(EOPNOTSUPP);
  CallerScope scope;
  if (scope.Enter() < 0) return -1;
  if (g_reusable.admission.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 1) return Error(ESHUTDOWN);
  ReusableGate gate;
  if (gate.Enter() < 0) return -1;
  if (g_reusable.admission.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 1) return Error(ESHUTDOWN);
  Request request{static_cast<pid_t>(syscall(SYS_gettid)), fd, operation, context};
  g_reusable.slot.store(&request, std::memory_order_release);
  g_reusable.command.store(1, std::memory_order_release);
  NotifyReusable();
  for (;;) {
    const int observed = g_reusable.event.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (request.complete.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) break;
    WaitReusableEvent(observed);
  }
  errno = request.error;
  return request.result;
}

void ResetReusableMetadataOwnerAfterPrivateFork() {
  // This function is called only in a private-memory child, including libc
  // fork's child hook. The copied gate may have been held by a vanished thread.
  // No lock, old pthread handle or copied stack request is touched.
  g_reusable.admission.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_reusable.gate.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_reusable.event.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_reusable.command.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_reusable.slot.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_reusable.startup_done.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_reusable.exited.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_reusable.startup_error = 0;
  g_reusable.poison = 0;
  g_reusable.thread = pthread_t{};
  g_reusable.joinable = false;
  // Keep the inherited anonymous stack mapping. The vanished thread cannot
  // use this child's private COW pages; Start may reuse them under low AS.
  g_reusable.process.store(CurrentProcess(), std::memory_order_release);
}

int StartReusableMetadataOwner() {
  const int incoming_errno = errno;
  const int process = CurrentProcess();
  const int registered = g_reusable.process.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
  if (registered != 0 && registered != process) return Error(EOPNOTSUPP);
  // An already-open owner needs no TLS, mask operation or gate acquisition.
  // A concurrent Stop can linearize immediately after this observation.
  if (g_reusable.admission.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 1) return 0;

  if (scope.Enter() < 0) return -1;
  int unassigned = 0;
  g_reusable.process.compare_exchange_strong(unassigned, process, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
  if (!OwnsReusableState()) return Error(EOPNOTSUPP);
  if (g_reusable.admission.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 2) return Error(EBUSY);
  ReusableGate gate;
  if (gate.Enter() < 0) return -1;
  if (g_reusable.admission.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 2) return Error(EBUSY);
  if (g_reusable.poison != 0) return Error(g_reusable.poison);

    int closed = 0;

    errno = incoming_errno;
    return 0;

    const int error = pthread_atfork(nullptr, nullptr, ResetReusableMetadataOwnerAfterPrivateFork);
    if (error != 0) return Error(error);
    g_reusable.atfork_registered = true;
  }
  pthread_attr_t attributes;
  int error = pthread_attr_init(&attributes);
  if (error != 0) return Error(error);
  if (g_reusable.stack_mapping == nullptr) {
    const long page = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    if (page <= 0 || static_cast<size_t>(page) > 128u * 1024u) {
      pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
      return Error(EINVAL);
    }
    const size_t page_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(page);
    const size_t stack_bytes = ((128u * 1024u + page_bytes - 1) / page_bytes) * page_bytes;
    const size_t mapping_bytes = stack_bytes + page_bytes;
    void* mapping = mmap(nullptr, mapping_bytes, PROT_NONE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
    if (mapping == MAP_FAILED) {
      const int saved = errno;
      pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
      return Error(saved);

      const int saved = errno;

      pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
      return Error(saved);

    // Its mapping is process-lifetime state, intentionally not freed by Stop.

    g_reusable.stack_base = stack;
    g_reusable.stack_size = stack_bytes;

  error = pthread_attr_setstack(&attributes, g_reusable.stack_base, g_reusable.stack_size);
  if (error != 0) {
    pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
    return Error(error);
  }
  g_reusable.startup_done.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_reusable.exited.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  g_reusable.command.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  error = pthread_create(&g_reusable.thread, &attributes, RunReusable, nullptr);
  pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
  if (error != 0) return Error(error);
  g_reusable.joinable = true;
  for (;;) {
    const int observed = g_reusable.event.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (g_reusable.startup_done.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) break;
    WaitReusableEvent(observed);
  }
  if (g_reusable.startup_error != 0) {
    const int startup_error = g_reusable.startup_error;
    const int joined = pthread_join(g_reusable.thread, nullptr);
    if (joined == 0) {
      g_reusable.joinable = false;
      g_reusable.thread = pthread_t{};
    } else {
      g_reusable.poison = joined;
    }
    return Error(joined != 0 ? joined : startup_error);
  }
  int closed = 0;
  if (!g_reusable.admission.compare_exchange_strong(closed, 1, std::memory_order_acq_rel) &&
      closed != 1) return Error(EBUSY);
  errno = incoming_errno;
  return 0;
}

int StopReusableMetadataOwner() {
  const int incoming_errno = errno;
  if (!g_reusable.enabled.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return 0;
  if (!OwnsReusableState()) return Error(EOPNOTSUPP);
  CallerScope scope;
  if (scope.Enter() < 0) return -1;
  // Close admission before waiting for a caller already holding the gate.
  if (g_reusable.admission.exchange(2, std::memory_order_acq_rel) == 2) return Error(EBUSY);
  int result = 0;
  int error = 0;
  {
    ReusableGate gate;
    if (gate.Enter() < 0) {
      result = -1;
      error = errno;
    } else if (g_reusable.poison != 0) {
      result = -1;
      error = g_reusable.poison;
    } else if (g_reusable.joinable) {
      g_reusable.command.store(2, std::memory_order_release);
      NotifyReusable();
      for (;;) {
        const int observed = g_reusable.event.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (g_reusable.exited.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) break;
        WaitReusableEvent(observed);
      }
      error = pthread_join(g_reusable.thread, nullptr);
      if (error == 0) {
        g_reusable.joinable = false;
        g_reusable.thread = pthread_t{};
      } else {
        g_reusable.poison = error;
        result = -1;
      }
    }
  }
  g_reusable.admission.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
  NotifyReusable();
  errno = result < 0 ? error : incoming_errno;
  return result;
}

int RunRequest(int fd, bool pin_caller_fd, Operation operation, Publication publication,
               void* context) {
  if (pin_caller_fd && fd < 0) return Error(EBADF);
  if (operation == nullptr) return Error(EINVAL);
  CallerScope scope;
  if (scope.Enter() < 0) return -1;
  Request request{static_cast<pid_t>(syscall(SYS_gettid)), fd, operation, context};
  request.pin_caller_fd = pin_caller_fd;
  request.publication = publication;
  pthread_attr_t attributes;
  int error = pthread_attr_init(&attributes);
  if (error != 0) return Error(error);
  // Bounds each in-flight query's stack; no heap queue or process-global
  // synchronization state survives a guest fork/exec.
  constexpr size_t kOwnerStackBytes = 128u * 1024u;
  error = pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attributes, kOwnerStackBytes);
  if (error != 0) {
    pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
    return Error(error);
  }
  pthread_t owner;
  error = pthread_create(&owner, &attributes, Run, &request);
  pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
  if (error != 0) return Error(error);
  int publication_result = -1;
  int publication_error = 0;
  if (publication != nullptr) {
    WaitWhile(&request, 0);
    if (request.phase.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 1) {
      publication_result = publication(request.publication_path, context);
      publication_error = errno;
      ChangePhase(&request, 2);
    }
  }
  error = pthread_join(owner, nullptr);
  if (error != 0) {
    // This private, joinable thread is never detached or exposed to another
    // joiner, and caller cancellation is disabled. Still do not allow an
    // unexpected libc error to leave a live callback using a dead stack.
    while (!request.complete.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) sched_yield();
    return Error(error);
  }
  if (!request.complete.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return Error(EIO);
  if (publication != nullptr && request.result == 0) {
    errno = publication_error;
    return publication_result;
  }
  errno = request.error;
  return request.result;
}

int ReadablePin(int pinned, const struct stat& identity) {
  const int flags = fcntl(pinned, F_GETFL);
  if (flags < 0) return -1;
  if ((flags & O_PATH) == 0) return fcntl(pinned, F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, 0);
  Fd directory(::open("/proc/thread-self/fd", O_PATH | O_DIRECTORY | O_CLOEXEC));
  if (directory.get() < 0) return -1;
  struct statfs directory_fs{};
  if (::fstatfs(directory.get(), &directory_fs) < 0) return -1;
  if (static_cast<uint64_t>(directory_fs.f_type) != PROC_SUPER_MAGIC) return Error(EXDEV);
  // A procfs mount can expose a different PID namespace's numeric names.
  // Reopening does not need to infer that namespace: the held owner pin and
  // the final inode equality below bind the actual object. This is separate
  // from readlink path-to-task resolution, which still needs that protocol.
  char number[32];
  const int length = snprintf(number, sizeof(number), "%d", pinned);
  if (length <= 0 || static_cast<size_t>(length) >= sizeof(number)) return Error(EOVERFLOW);
  Fd readable(::openat(directory.get(), number, O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC));
  if (readable.get() < 0) return -1;
  struct stat after{};
  if (::fstat(readable.get(), &after) < 0) return -1;
  if (!EqualInode(identity, after)) return Error(ESTALE);
  return readable.release();
}

    return Lookup::kError;

      origin->words[kBackingDevice] != static_cast<uint64_t>(actual.st_dev) ||
      origin->words[kBackingInode] != static_cast<uint64_t>(actual.st_ino) ||
      origin->words[kBackingSize] != static_cast<uint64_t>(actual.st_size)) {
    Error(ESTALE);
    return Lookup::kError;
  }
  struct stat final_info{};
  if (::fstat(readable.get(), &final_info) < 0) return Lookup::kError;

      actual.st_uid != final_info.st_uid || actual.st_gid != final_info.st_gid ||
      actual.st_size != final_info.st_size || final_info.st_nlink != 0) {
    Error(ESTALE);
    return Lookup::kError;

  if (RequireUnprivilegedInitialNamespace(config) < 0) return Lookup::kError;
  return Lookup::kVirtual;
}

int CopyKernel(int process, const void* source, void* destination, size_t size) {

  return 0;
#else
  (void)process; (void)local; (void)remote;
  return Error(ENOSYS);
#endif
}

bool Number(const char*& cursor, const char* end, int* value) {
  if (cursor == end || *cursor < '0' || *cursor > '9') return false;
  if (*cursor == '0' && cursor + 1 != end && cursor[1] >= '0' && cursor[1] <= '9') return false;
  unsigned result = 0;
  while (cursor != end && *cursor >= '0' && *cursor <= '9') {
    const unsigned digit = static_cast<unsigned>(*cursor++ - '0');
    if (result > (static_cast<unsigned>(INT_MAX) - digit) / 10) return false;
    result = result * 10 + digit;
  }
  *value = static_cast<int>(result);
  return true;
}

bool Consume(const char*& cursor, const char* end, const char* literal) {
  const size_t size = strlen(literal);
  if (size > static_cast<size_t>(end - cursor) || memcmp(cursor, literal, size) != 0) return false;
  cursor += size;
  return true;
}

bool ParseProcFd(const char* path, size_t size, int* tid, int* descriptor) {
  const char* cursor = path;
  const char* end = path + size;
  int tgid;
  if (!Consume(cursor, end, "/proc/") || !Number(cursor, end, &tgid) || tgid <= 0) return false;
  *tid = tgid;
  if (end - cursor >= 6 && memcmp(cursor, "/task/", 6) == 0) {
    cursor += 6;
    if (!Number(cursor, end, tid) || *tid <= 0) return false;
  }
  return Consume(cursor, end, "/fd/") && Number(cursor, end, descriptor) && cursor == end;
}

int ReceiveSnapshotReply(int connection) {
  unsigned char reply[kReplyBytes];

  struct iovec reply_iov{reply, sizeof(reply)};

  message.msg_iov = &reply_iov;
  message.msg_iovlen = 1;
  message.msg_control = receive_control;
  message.msg_controllen = sizeof(receive_control);
  const ssize_t received = recvmsg(connection, &message, MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC);
  if (received < 0) return -1;
  int received_fd = -1;
  size_t fd_count = 0;
  bool invalid_control = false;
  for (struct cmsghdr* ancillary = CMSG_FIRSTHDR(&message); ancillary; ancillary = CMSG_NXTHDR(&message, ancillary)) {
    if (ancillary->cmsg_level != SOL_SOCKET || ancillary->cmsg_type != SCM_RIGHTS ||
        ancillary->cmsg_len < CMSG_LEN(0)) {
      // SO_PASSPIDFD can be changed by another thread sharing this socket.
      // Reject its known FD-bearing header, but first adopt and close the one
      // descriptor installed by recvmsg. Non-FD ancillary remains untouched.
      if (ancillary->cmsg_level == SOL_SOCKET && ancillary->cmsg_type == kScmPidfd &&
          ancillary->cmsg_len >= CMSG_LEN(sizeof(int))) {
        int pidfd;
        memcpy(&pidfd, CMSG_DATA(ancillary), sizeof(pidfd));
        Fd rejected_pidfd(pidfd);
      }
      invalid_control = true;
      continue;
    }
    const size_t count_bytes = ancillary->cmsg_len - CMSG_LEN(0);
    if (count_bytes % sizeof(int) != 0) invalid_control = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i + sizeof(int) <= count_bytes; i += sizeof(int)) {
      int descriptor;
      memcpy(&descriptor, CMSG_DATA(ancillary) + i, sizeof(descriptor));
      if (fd_count++ == 0) received_fd = descriptor;
      else { Fd extra(descriptor); }
    }
  }
  Fd output(received_fd);
  if (invalid_control || (message.msg_flags & (MSG_TRUNC | MSG_CTRUNC)) != 0 ||
      received != sizeof(reply) || memcmp(reply, kReplyMagic, 8) != 0 ||
      GetU32(reply + 8) != kVersion || !AllZero(reply + 16, 16)) return Error(EPROTO);
  const uint32_t error = GetU32(reply + 12);

    if (fd_count != 0 || error > 4095) return Error(EPROTO);
    return Error(static_cast<int>(error));
  }
  if (fd_count != 1 || output.get() < 0) return Error(EPROTO);
  return output.release();

int RequireUnprivilegedInitialNamespace(const Configuration& config) {
  if (config.initial_userns_device != kTrustedUserNamespaceDevice ||
      config.initial_userns_inode != kTrustedUserNamespaceInode) return Error(EINVAL);
  uid_t real, effective, saved;
  if (getresuid(&real, &effective, &saved) < 0) return -1;
  const long fsuid = syscall(SYS_setfsuid, static_cast<uid_t>(-1));
  if (real == 0 || effective == 0 || saved == 0 || fsuid <= 0) return Error(EPERM);
  struct __user_cap_header_struct header{_LINUX_CAPABILITY_VERSION_3, 0};
  struct __user_cap_data_struct caps[2]{};
  if (syscall(SYS_capget, &header, caps) < 0) return -1;
  for (const auto& cap : caps) {
    if (cap.effective != 0 || cap.permitted != 0 || cap.inheritable != 0) return Error(EPERM);
  }
  // Linux maintains ambient as a subset of permitted & inheritable, both zero.
  Fd self(PidfdOpen(static_cast<pid_t>(syscall(SYS_gettid))));
  if (self.get() < 0) return -1;
  return CheckUserNamespace(self.get(), config);
}

Lookup QueryOrigin(int fd, const Configuration& config, Origin* origin) {
  const int incoming_errno = errno;
  struct stat actual{};
  if (::fstat(fd, &actual) < 0) return Lookup::kError;
  if (!MayBeVirtual(actual)) return Lookup::kOrdinary;
  MetadataRequest request{&config, MetadataOperation::kOrigin};
  if (ReadOwnedMetadata(fd, &request) < 0) return Lookup::kError;
  if (request.lookup == Lookup::kVirtual) *origin = request.origin;
  errno = incoming_errno;
  return request.lookup;
}

int Fstat(int fd, struct stat* result, const Configuration& config) {
  const int incoming_errno = errno;
  struct stat actual{};
  if (::fstat(fd, &actual) < 0) return -1;
  if (!MayBeVirtual(actual)) {
    // Return this single kernel observation; do not re-read a possibly reused
    // fd or allocate a helper merely to answer an ordinary metadata query.
    *result = actual;
    return 0;
  }
  MetadataRequest request{&config, MetadataOperation::kStat};
  if (ReadOwnedMetadata(fd, &request) < 0) return -1;
  *result = request.info;
  errno = incoming_errno;
  return 0;
}

int Fstatfs(int fd, struct statfs* result, const Configuration& config) {
  const int incoming_errno = errno;
  struct statfs actual{};
  if (::fstatfs(fd, &actual) < 0) return -1;
  if (static_cast<uint64_t>(actual.f_type) != TMPFS_MAGIC) {
    // This one syscall is a complete ordinary result. For tmpfs, separate
    // fstat/fstatfs observations cannot exclude A->virtual->A fd-table races.
    *result = actual;
    return 0;
  }
  MetadataRequest request{&config, MetadataOperation::kStatfs};
  if (ReadOwnedMetadata(fd, &request) < 0) return -1;
  *result = request.filesystem;
  errno = incoming_errno;
  return 0;
}

  const int status_flags = fcntl(source.get(), F_GETFL);

      setsockopt(connection.get(), SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &timeout, sizeof(timeout)) < 0) return -1;

  // Once the authenticated reply and immutable inode have been validated,
  // a normal factory exit does not invalidate the object. The PIDFD stayed
  // held throughout reception; no lifetime now depends on the service.

}

  // ordinary symlinks at full RLIMIT_NOFILE, without ANY helper descriptor or

  // have been replaced by a virtual link between the two observations.

      memcmp(observed, kSnapshotKernelPath, sizeof(kSnapshotKernelPath) - 1) == 0;

      *result = -1;

    selected_size = static_cast<size_t>(request.output_size);

  const size_t count = std::min(selected_size, static_cast<size_t>(kernel_size));
  if (CopyToCaller(selected, buffer, count) < 0) { *result = -1; return true; }
  *result = static_cast<ssize_t>(count);
  errno = incoming_errno;
  return true;
}
